title: Rei event streams
description: The JSON data of every server-sent event, by stream and event name. The SSE framing is described in docs/contract.md.

global.summary: Agents, the session list, pending approvals and takeovers, and change notices.

session.summary: One session's Conversation View: a snapshot, then patches.

A2uiComponent.description: An A2UI v1.0 component from Rei's catalog; its properties follow the catalog.
A2uiComponent.title: A2uiComponent

avatar.description: `bot:<id>`, a `data:image/...` picture, or an emoji or short badge.

unavailable.description: Only the name is known (an imported file the import did not carry): why.

agentId.description: The companion agent: the user's pick, or the default agent when none is set.

homeSessionId.description: The companion agent's home chat, where a companion client quick-sends.

cursor.description: The cursor this snapshot is at; a reconnect resumes after it.

text.description: Markdown in the Rei dialect (docs/rendering.md) for user and assistant items.

thinking.description: An imported reply's reasoning, for detail mode; never model context.

start.description: UTF-16 offset into the message text.

preview.description: Plain text of the last message, at most 200 characters.

unread.description: Agent entries after the read marker every device shares.

fallback.description: Plain text carrying everything the surface shows.
